name: Benji
self_text: I'm a Canadian man in my mid 30s who spends my free time collecting vinyl. I use a Leica and I'm honestly just looking for a practice session working on specific shots. I tend to go at a fast pace, as that's how I enjoy it. Most weeks I can do Saturday morning or Sunday morning. Fair warning, gear talk is fine but not the point is my thing. I'm also cool with not taking portraits of each other.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a practice session working on specific shots or a relaxed photo walk. It would also be nice if you are okay with no gear debates, but no big deal.
